name: @mirri-ai/mirri-desktop-lite
description: Mirri Code Lite — the Electrobun lightweight desktop shell (experimental)

scripts.assets: hutch pm exec -- vite build && node scripts/build-preload.mjs
scripts.dev: hutch electrobun prepare && pnpm -C . run assets && hutch electrobun dev
scripts.build: hutch electrobun prepare && pnpm -C . run assets && hutch electrobun build --env=stable
